brief: Concept: a patch bay (an MCP server is a cable between an agent and monday.com). It is UNOFFICIAL: never use monday.com's logo, purple or its coloured dots; say "Unofficial. Not affiliated with monday.com." in README and Hero. Colours: paper #f5f6f8 (ground), ink #1d2433, cable-teal #1f6f78, patch-orange #d9661f (non-text), orange-ink #9c4310, muted #5b6474, rule #d5d9e0. Type: "Schibsted Grotesk" 700 display and 400 body, "JetBrains Mono" for commands. Wordmark: "monday-mcp" lowercase Schibsted Grotesk 700. Cover pattern: pills - patch-bay jacks in rows, radius = half the short side. Hero: name, "A local MCP server for monday.com. Your API token stays on your machine." (adjust to README facts), action "Read the setup".
